purpose: Runs the real video tool with Apple's avconvert on made videos and the laid floor, and checks each new file and the original left as it was.
title: A clip, the sound or a smaller copy, never over the original

testCases.description: a clip between two times by avconvert, twice from one video, each a new file, neither over the other, the original unchanged
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-helpers.test.js::a clip of the owner's own video between two times is cut on the Mac by Apple's avconvert into a new file in the owner's folder, twice from the same video, each a new file, neither over the other, and the original never written over or changed

testCases.description: just the sound by avconvert as a new audio file with no picture, the original unchanged
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-helpers.test.js::just the sound of the owner's own video is kept on the Mac by Apple's avconvert as a new audio file in the owner's folder, with no picture, the original never written over or changed

testCases.description: a smaller copy by avconvert, at most 1280 by 720, without the video's location data, the original unchanged
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-helpers.test.js::a smaller copy of the owner's own video to share is made on the Mac by Apple's avconvert as a new file in the owner's folder, its picture at most 1280 by 720 and without the video's location data, the original never written over or changed

testCases.description: the clip, the sound and the smaller copy the session loads are each asked by the laid floor as video and audio work, never free or refused, in both modes
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-helpers.test.js::the clip, just the sound and the smaller copy, each named by what the session loads, are asked by the safety floor as the session runs it, the question naming video and audio work, never free and never refused, in the default mode and in auto mode
